result.topic_en: An algebraic calculation in the theory of curved surfaces: an expression Ω built from the derivatives of m𝔈, m𝔉, m𝔊 with respect to p and q, using 𝔉𝔉 − 𝔈𝔊 = hh/4mm, is expanded term by term and the terms are cancelled (red numbering), giving a correction to be added to an earlier expression.
result.transcription:
$\frac{1}{2}mm\,hh$
$2mm(\mathfrak{F}\mathfrak{F}-\mathfrak{E}\mathfrak{G})\Big\{\frac{ddm\mathfrak{E}}{dq^2}-2\frac{ddm\mathfrak{F}}{dp.dq}+\frac{ddm\mathfrak{G}}{dp^2}\Big\}$
$[-+mm-]\,\mathfrak{E}\Big\{\frac{dm\mathfrak{E}}{dq}\cdot\frac{dm\mathfrak{G}}{dq}-2\frac{dm\mathfrak{F}}{dp}\cdot\frac{dm\mathfrak{G}}{dq}+\big(\frac{dm\mathfrak{G}}{dp}\big)^2\Big\}$
$+m\mathfrak{F}\Big(\frac{dm\mathfrak{E}}{dp}\cdot\frac{dm\mathfrak{G}}{dq}-2\frac{dm\mathfrak{E}}{dq}\cdot\frac{dm\mathfrak{F}}{dq}+4\frac{dm\mathfrak{F}}{dp}\cdot\frac{dm\mathfrak{F}}{dq}$
$-\frac{dm\mathfrak{E}}{dq}\cdot\frac{dm\mathfrak{G}}{dp}[-2\frac{dm\mathfrak{E}}{dq}-]-2\frac{dm\mathfrak{F}}{dp}\cdot\frac{dm\mathfrak{G}}{dp}\Big)$
$+m\mathfrak{G}\Big(\frac{dm\mathfrak{E}}{dp}\cdot\frac{dm\mathfrak{G}}{dp}-2\frac{dm\mathfrak{E}}{dp}\cdot\frac{dm\mathfrak{F}}{dq}+\big(\frac{dm\mathfrak{E}}{dq}\big)^2\Big)\Big\}=\Omega$

$\mathfrak{F}\mathfrak{F}-\mathfrak{E}\mathfrak{G}=\frac{hh}{4mm}$

Es muß also zu dem Ausdruck von $\frac{\Delta\Delta}{\ldots}$[?] hinzugefügt werden
$\frac{2}{mh^4}\Omega$, woraus dann hervorgeht

$\frac{1}{hh}\Big\{[-2\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dq}\cdot\frac{dm}{dq}-]-[-2\frac{dm}{dp}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dq}-]+2\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dp}\cdot\frac{dm}{dp}$
$+m\frac{dd\mathfrak{E}}{dq^2}[-2\frac{dm}{dq}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dp}-]-2m\frac{dd\mathfrak{F}}{dp\,dq}+m\frac{dd\mathfrak{G}}{dp^2}\Big)$
bleibt noch aus 5 und 6 $+\frac{1}{hh}\Big(\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dq}\cdot\frac{dm}{dq}+\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dp}\cdot\frac{dm}{dp}\Big)$

$+\frac{\ldots}{mh^4}\Big\{mm\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dq}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dq}-2mm\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dp}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dq}+mm\big(\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dp}\big)^2$
$+m\mathfrak{E}\frac{dm}{dq}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dq}+m\mathfrak{G}\frac{dm}{dq}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dq}[-2m\mathfrak{G}\frac{dm}{dq}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dp}-][-2m\mathfrak{F}\frac{dm}{dp}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dq}-][-+2m\mathfrak{G}\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dp}\cdot\frac{dm}{dp}-]$
$+\mathfrak{E}\mathfrak{G}\big(\frac{dm}{dq}\big)^2-2\mathfrak{F}\mathfrak{G}\frac{dm}{dp}\cdot\frac{dm}{dq}+\mathfrak{G}\mathfrak{G}\big(\frac{dm}{dp}\big)^2\Big\}$
$+2mm\mathfrak{G}\frac{dm}{dq}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dp}$ (statt 8) $\;-m\mathfrak{F}\frac{dm}{dq}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dp}$ (statt 10)

$+\frac{2m\mathfrak{F}}{mh^4}\Big\{mm\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dp}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dq}-2mm\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dq}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dq}+4mm\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dp}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dq}-mm\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dq}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dp}-2mm\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dp}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dp}$
$[-+m\mathfrak{E}\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dq}\cdot\frac{dm}{dp}-]-m\mathfrak{G}\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dq}\cdot\frac{dm}{dp}+4m\mathfrak{F}\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dq}\cdot\frac{dm}{dp}-m\mathfrak{G}\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dp}\cdot\frac{dm}{dq}[-2m\mathfrak{G}\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dq}\cdot\frac{dm}{dp}-]\ldots$
$+\mathfrak{E}\mathfrak{G}\frac{dm}{dp}\cdot\frac{dm}{dq}-2\mathfrak{E}\mathfrak{F}\big(\frac{dm}{dq}\big)^2+4\mathfrak{F}\mathfrak{F}\frac{dm}{dp}\cdot\frac{dm}{dq}-\mathfrak{E}\mathfrak{G}\frac{dm}{dp}\cdot\frac{dm}{dq}-2\mathfrak{F}\mathfrak{G}\big(\frac{dm}{dp}\big)^2\Big\}$

$+\frac{2\mathfrak{G}}{mh^4}\Big\{mm\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dp}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dp}-2mm\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dp}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dq}+mm\big(\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dq}\big)^2$
$+m\mathfrak{E}\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dp}\cdot\frac{dm}{dp}+m\mathfrak{G}\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dp}\cdot\frac{dm}{dp}[-2m\mathfrak{E}\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dq}\cdot\frac{dm}{dp}-][-2m\mathfrak{F}\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dp}\cdot\frac{dm}{dq}-][-+2m\mathfrak{E}\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dq}\cdot\frac{dm}{dq}-]$
$+\mathfrak{E}\mathfrak{G}\big(\frac{dm}{dp}\big)^2-2\mathfrak{E}\mathfrak{F}\frac{dm}{dp}\cdot\frac{dm}{dq}+\mathfrak{E}\mathfrak{E}\big(\frac{dm}{dq}\big)^2\Big\}$
$+2m\mathfrak{E}\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dq}\cdot\frac{dm}{dp}$ (statt 7) $\;-m\mathfrak{F}\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dq}\cdot\frac{dm}{dp}$ (statt 9)

woraus dann zusammen erhellt
$\frac{h}{2m}[-\ldots-]+\frac{\ldots}{2}$
$\frac{1}{dm}\Big\{-2\mathfrak{E}\mathfrak{F}\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dq}-2\mathfrak{F}\mathfrak{G}\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dq}+4\mathfrak{F}\mathfrak{F}\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dq}+2\mathfrak{E}\mathfrak{G}\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dq}+4\mathfrak{E}\mathfrak{G}\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dp}+2\mathfrak{G}\mathfrak{G}\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dp}\Big\}$
$+\frac{1}{hh}\big(\frac{dm}{dp}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dp}+\frac{dm}{dq}\cdot\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dq}\big)$
$+\frac{1}{dm}\Big\{2\mathfrak{E}\mathfrak{E}\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dq}+2\mathfrak{E}\mathfrak{G}\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dq}+4\mathfrak{E}\mathfrak{G}\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dq}-4\mathfrak{F}\mathfrak{F}\frac{d\mathfrak{F}}{dp}-2\mathfrak{E}\mathfrak{F}\frac{d\mathfrak{G}}{dp}-2\mathfrak{F}\mathfrak{G}\frac{d\mathfrak{E}}{dp}\Big\}$
$+\frac{hh}{\ldots}\Big\{\mathfrak{E}\mathfrak{G}-2\mathfrak{F}\mathfrak{F}+\mathfrak{G}\mathfrak{E}\Big\}\div\frac{h^3}{2}\times(\mathfrak{E}\mathfrak{G}-2\mathfrak{F}\mathfrak{F}+\mathfrak{G}\mathfrak{E})$
[-was sich daselbst vielleicht unter richtiger Construction der Zeichen ...-]
